bias.zh: 看空 · 回落至 $186–189 下方

read.en: Bloom Energy fell 4.4% on Nov 10 to $185.42, trading $181.01–194.68. It is above the 5-day ($184.1) and below the 10-day ($198.4), 30-day ($233.3), 100-day ($239.7) and 200-day ($222.9); only the 200-day is rising. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 8, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 4 ($222.21), and RSI is 41.
read.zh: Bloom Energy 11月10日下跌 4.4%，收于 $185.42，盘中区间 $181.01–194.68。股价位于 5 日（$184.1）均线上方，10 日（$198.4）、30 日（$233.3）、100 日（$239.7）和 200 日（$222.9）均线下方；仅 200 日均线在上行。MACD 自 10月8日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月4日起看空（$222.21），RSI 为 41。

read.en: The close lost the $185.9–189 support (Aug 24 and Oct 23 lows), now resistance, after the $194.68 high stalled at the Oct 30–Nov 2 lows; the 5-day ($184.1) held. Resistance is $185.9–189, then $194.2–199.8 (Oct 30 and Nov 2 lows, 10-day $198.4, Nov 9 high) and $222.2–222.9 (SAR, 200-day). Support is $180.5–184.1, then $168.8 and $156. A close above $189 would target $194–199.8; below $180.5, $168.8.

r.en: Oct 30 and Nov 2 lows ($194.2–194.9); 10-day average $198.4; Nov 9 high $199.83
